name: WeedEx: Drug Express Delivery
detailed_description:
Start from Nothing, Rule Everything

Stranded in Hyland Point — a corrupt coastal metropolis where crime is survival. You’re a broke, unknown street dealer with no connections, no product, and a city that wants you dead. Every district has its rules. Only the ruthless rise.

Build Your Empire

Dominate the Underworld by growing, mixing, and selling illicit products:

  • Craft Cheap Street Drugs to high-value designer strains.

  • Experiment with Formulas: Mix components, unlock rare goods, and create unique products that crush competitors.

  • Control Demand: Flood the streets with exclusive substances to become the city’s top supplier.

Survive the Pressure

Navigate a Treacherous World:

  • Evade Police: Outsmart raids, investigations.

  • Crush Rivals: Battle gangs and cartels.

  • Risk It All: One wrong move means jail — or a bullet.

Expand Your Operation

Invest Blood Money Wisely:

  • Buy Properties: Secure labs, stash houses, and territory.

  • Arm Your Crew: Upgrade from rusty vans to armored vehicles that survive high-speed chases.

  • Acquire Rare Gear: Source cutting-edge equipment and ingredients to boost production.

Become Untouchable

Innovate. Dominate. Conquer.
Master the criminal ecosystem of Hyland Point — where only the smartest, fiercest, and most cunning rule the underworld.

The Streets Are Waiting. How Far Will You Go?

short_description: Start as a street dealer and rise to criminal power — produce and distribute various illegal substances across the dark streets of Hyland Point. Expand your empire by purchasing property, growing your business, acquiring new cars, and building a powerful underground network.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1650
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any, which can handle sound output
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: No

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains the following content, which may be inappropriate for younger or sensitive players:
- Drug Use & Drug Dealing
Depicts the production, sale of a variety of illegal drugs. Scenes include characters cooking, transporting, and negotiating deals.
- Violence & Criminal Acts
Frequent depictions of street-level criminal activity.
